text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Share of observed power below the 1% and 5% quantiles, and above the 95% and 99% quantiles, divided by the nominal share. Below 1 means the band is too wide, above 1 too narrow. 3 wind farms, 53 Tuesday runs, 3 seeds, July 2025 to June 2026, rows kept by the idle-band mask.'
text.tspan: Share of observed power below the 1% and 5% quantiles, and above the 95% and 99% quantiles,
divided by the nominal share. Below 1 means the band is too wide, above 1 too narrow. 3 wind
farms, 53 Tuesday runs, 3 seeds, July 2025 to June 2026, rows kept by the idle-band mask.
